summary: ADR-0048 accepted 2026-07-26; extends ADR-0044, complements ADR-0037/0041/0043, supersedes none; source and accepted ADRs are fact authority; projections/indexes=derived_cache; deterministic Locator returns locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence only; callers must reread and hash-verify sources; trusted adapters constrain domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence; LLM query intent untrusted and cannot widen envelope; VDD records post-reread accept/reject; rejected candidates cannot satisfy required modules; uncovered required module blocks readiness; Quick Dev consumes only VDD-frozen accepted decisions; Bootstrap Review may locate pre-prepare then freezes Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback default-disabled; approved fallback Python entrypoint=scripts/sc/_llm_backend.py::run_llm_exec; maintenance pins refs/heads/main, no implicit fetch/checkout/merge/branch mutation; record derived artifacts plus append-only evidence; failures fail closed for missing/stale/low-confidence/out-of-policy/hash-drift; excludes phase routes, Hosted E2 dispatch, live metadata, deployment/acceptance/handoff/release/commit.
